name: Steal the Steel!
author: pocketlint60
description:
Play as a crafty goblin and sneak around an army of surly dwarves to snatch their painstakingly crafted weapons for yourself! 

Controls:
Arrows - Movement
Space - Fire
Shift (Hold) - Walk
Control (Hold) - Aiming Mode (while standing still)

This is my first completely playable game and was made as my project for Unity's Junior Programmer Learning Path. 

I recommend the downloadable EXE version from itch.io: https://pocketlint60.itch.io/steeal
